author: Arachadonic
body:
This is my idea for a new mini-game that I got of from the old Classic Minecraft "Zombie Survival" mode. For anyone who never played this game-mode then let me fill you in briefly:

There are two sides; Survivors/Warriors/Humans/Angels and Hunters/Infected/Undead/Demons:

  • As a Survivor the objective is to survive (duh) by any means possible i.e running, hiding, fighting until the time runs out. You would spawn with a kit randomly out of say 1-5 kits the map maker has made. If a demon kills you then you become a demon and spawn with a kit that differs per map.
  • The Demons (name up to debate) would be chosen out of the survivors randomly after a few minutes into the map. When the Demon gets chosen, they get a kit that would be better than the survivors since he will be heavily outnumbered (maybe like iron weapons, no diamond). The first demon chosen would have the title of "DarkDemon" or something and when he dies the first inital OP kit he gets goes and he cannot get it back. He must use the default kits that the other newly infected Demons get. N.B For larger maps prehaps more than one demon could be chosen at first if indeed it is too hard during testing.
 

Okay so that is the basic overview of the teams. Now onto some specifics!

Time allowed for each match: 1-5 minutes until the demon is chosen so use that time to look around the map for loot and equipment. Once the Demon is chosen the match (depending on the map size) could last for maybe 20-40 minutes. Should be enough time to kill kill kill!

The amount of players in a match: I think 16 people for small maps and 24 for big maps. No more than 24 though as it would be too hard on the first hunter.

Types of Map: I envisage really any types of maps, similar to a survival games type map with chests all over the place and special enchanted items to help the survivors. A good mix of parkour is welcome aswell as there is not really that much parkour on the server. Maps that you can break/place blocks on I think would be best as it allows for a lot more variety in how you choose to play the game.

Rules: These are just some basic rules I thought up for this gamemode. 
  1. The general server rules apply, i.e No bad language, no hacking etc.
  2. No pillaring/towering, i.e placing blocks beneath you as you go up up up creating big unsightly towers that can ruin the gameplay.
  3. No hiding in little holes, i.e you cant just crouch in a 1x1x1 box for the whole game as that would get boring for the hunters and everyone involved. A minium of say 5x5x5 or there abouts should be okay.
I know that coding this might be a challenge but I think it would be worth it and I think this idea is semi-original in that I haven't seen it on many servers and there is nothing like it on the big mini-game servers. All the names/times are up for debate so PLEASE give me your opinion or what you want to see below!
